item.title: Bill Discounting vs Factoring: Difference and Comparison
item.description: Bill discounting involves the purchase of a bill of exchange at a discounted rate before its maturity date, while factoring is a financial service where a business sells its receivables to a third party at a discount.

item.title: Conduction vs Convection, vs Radiation: Difference and Comparison
item.description: Conduction is the transfer of heat through direct contact between materials, convection is the transfer of heat through the movement of fluids, and radiation is the transfer of heat through electromagnetic waves.

item.title: Probation vs Parole: Difference and Comparison
item.description: Probation is a court-ordered period of supervision in the community as an alternative to incarceration, while parole is the conditional release of a prisoner before completing their sentence, allowing them to serve the remainder under supervision in the community.

item.title: Compound vs Mixture: Difference and Comparison
item.description: A compound is a substance formed when two or more elements chemically bond together, while a mixture consists of two or more substances that are physically combined without a chemical bond.

item.title: Cardinal vs Ordinal Utility: Difference and Comparison
item.description: Cardinal utility is a quantitative measure of satisfaction derived from consuming goods or services, while ordinal utility involves ranking preferences based on relative satisfaction without assigning numerical values.
